label: Product and Outfit Link Requests
definition: This cluster captures comments asking for direct URLs or links to specific items featured in posts. Users want to know where to buy the exact product shown.
include_when: The post explicitly asks for a link, URL, or place to buy a specific product.
exclude_when: The post discusses brand recommendations without asking for a direct purchase link.
example_quotes: Green suit link || Linkkk plssssss

label: Brand and Store Recommendations
definition: This cluster captures requests for brand advice as well as specific brand recommendations or reviews given by users.
include_when: The post recommends a specific brand or asks for brand alternatives and reviews.
exclude_when: The post requests a direct link to a specific clothing item instead of brand-level guidance.
example_quotes: Buy a Birkenstock || I think go for Levi's

label: Color and Style Preferences
definition: This cluster covers mentions of product colors, including asking for specific color links, preferences for bright colors, and noticing differences between expected and received colors.
include_when: The post discusses color choices, requests specific color links, or reports color discrepancies.
exclude_when: The post focuses on general sizing or overall app experience without mentioning color.
example_quotes: Mam can u kindly attach link for the white colour top || Bright colours and print, soft fall, just what i was looking for.

label: Outfit and Style Suggestions
definition: This cluster contains requests for clothing styling tips, outfit recommendations, or specific garment combinations for upcoming events. It is driven by users asking others for fashion advice.
include_when: The post asks for outfit suggestions, clothing pairings, or style recommendations for an event.
exclude_when: The post reviews purchased items or evaluates product quality without asking for fashion advice.
example_quotes: Suggestions are recommended || i have one request if you suggest some farshi salwar suit set for this wedding season

label: Sharing Links and Search Details
definition: This cluster contains posts where users share specific product links, purchase sources, or search details with others. It is centered around directing others to a specific item.
include_when: The post shares a direct product link, purchase source, or search terms for an item.
exclude_when: The post asks general questions about sizing or expresses a return policy.
example_quotes: Yes purchas this link || Search this in Myntra : Stylish Peach-Coloured Women V-Neck Puff Sleeves Fit and Flare Maxi Dress MRP ₹2,199 Rating: 4.2 ⭐

label: Considers Purchase Worthwhile
definition: This cluster groups posts where customers express satisfaction that a purchase was worthwhile and obtained at a reasonable price.
include_when: Include when the post states that an item is worth buying or was acquired at a reasonable price.
exclude_when: Exclude when the post complains about poor quality or defective items.
example_quotes: Worth buying this cord set || Got tshirt at good and reasonable price..ucb quality best

label: Coupons and Promotional Savings
definition: This cluster groups posts discussing promotional offers, discounts, cashback rewards, vouchers, and coupon applications during orders or replacements.
include_when: The post mentions discounts, coupons, reward cash, cashback, or promotional vouchers.
exclude_when: The post discusses general payment methods or order placement without mentioning promotional incentives.

label: Purchasing Discounted Products
definition: This cluster involves users mentioning purchases made from a specific retailer while taking advantage of promotional offers and discounts. It centers on deal-seeking behavior and general platform transactions.
include_when: The post mentions buying items from an online retailer while highlighting discounts or offers.
exclude_when: The post focuses on product authenticity or specific item quality without mentioning promotions.
example_quotes: I am purchase from myntra || Really good to buy some offers on a products from Myntra

label: High Item Prices
definition: This cluster groups feedback where shoppers note that specific item prices are too expensive or higher than those on alternative shopping platforms.
include_when: The post mentions that prices are high, expensive, or cost more than other apps.
exclude_when: The user is asking a question about a specific product price or inquiring about current costs.
example_quotes: discountable rates but the prices of the item is higher then other shoping platform || I had a good experience with Myntra, but its prices are higher compared to other apps.

label: Credit and Wallet Usage
definition: This cluster includes inquiries and statements regarding store credits, wallet usage, credit restrictions, and bank transfers of credits.
include_when: The post discusses using shopping app credits, wallet funds, or transferring credits to a bank.
exclude_when: The post discusses general app experience or product returns without mentioning credits.

label: Platform Fee Avoidance

include_when: Include when the post complains about, avoids, or celebrates placing an order without a platform fee.

label: Price Inquiries and Cost Questions
definition: This cluster captures user questions and inquiries regarding the exact current price of an item or specific brand pricing details.

label: Product Quality Praise
definition: This cluster contains positive feedback praising the quality, appearance, fit, or overall goodness of purchased products.
include_when: The post expresses satisfaction with the physical characteristics, appearance, or quality of an item.
exclude_when: The post compliments delivery speed or platform features rather than the item itself.

label: Complaints About Poor Quality
definition: This cluster includes customer grievances regarding poor product quality, items that do not match expectations, or receiving unusable merchandise.
include_when: Include when the post criticizes cheap quality, item mismatch, or receiving items that cannot be worn.
exclude_when: Exclude when the post praises product quality or evaluates items as reasonably priced.

label: Product Quality Inquiries
definition: This cluster captures posts where users ask questions or express uncertainty regarding the quality and durability of fashion items. It focuses strictly on inquiries about the material or overall build rather than sizing or shipping.
include_when: The user asks whether an item has good quality or inquires about how a product holds up.

label: Soft Fabric Praise and Desire
definition: This cluster groups posts that either praise the softness of a clothing fabric or express a desire to find and purchase soft garments. It centers on the tactile quality of clothing materials.
include_when: Include when the post explicitly mentions soft fabric, stretchability, or looking for soft material in clothing.
exclude_when: Exclude when the post discusses overall clothing quality, fit, or color without mentioning the softness of the fabric.
example_quotes: Must buy , very soft and stretchable || Bright colours and print, soft fall, just what i was looking for.

label: Accurate Product Representation
definition: This cluster highlights customer satisfaction regarding items matching their online descriptions and visual representations. It reflects positive experiences where delivered goods look exactly as advertised.
include_when: The post states that received products look exactly like or match their online pictures.
exclude_when: The post discusses user-submitted photo reviews rather than the accuracy of the product itself.

label: Sizing and Fit Evaluations
definition: This cluster includes posts where users evaluate or ask questions about clothing dimensions, tightness, length, and overall fit. It is specific to how a garment fits the body.
include_when: The user asks about measurements, height compatibility, or mentions that an item is tight or well-fitted.
exclude_when: The post talks about material quality, return processes, or searching for products.
example_quotes: good product little tight || Is this jeans fine for a height of 5'7?

label: Size Availability and Inquiries
definition: This cluster captures comments and questions regarding product sizes, availability, and incorrect sizing. It focuses on sizing struggles and stock availability rather than general product quality.
include_when: The post asks about available sizes, requests sizing recommendations, or mentions receiving the wrong size.
exclude_when: The post discusses general product quality or prices without mentioning size.
example_quotes: Dear, 46 size available nahin hai || Size kya hai bataiye na didi plzz🥺🥺

label: Fast and Reliable Delivery
definition: This cluster groups positive remarks about receiving orders quickly, timely deliveries, and smooth shipping experiences.
include_when: The post links fast shipping, on-time delivery, or a smooth delivery process to a purchase — as a reason to buy, or as part of an order the poster is actively choosing, placing or tracking.
exclude_when: Delivery praise with no purchase context; the post focuses on product quality or customer support.

label: Order Cancellations and Refunds
definition: This cluster covers instances where users experience order cancellations by the platform or encounter issues related to getting refunds after a cancelled purchase.
include_when: The cancellation or refund issue is discussed as a reason the poster will not order again, will delay, will switch, or will add checks next time — the complaint changes a future buying decision.
exclude_when: A standalone refund or cancellation complaint with no link to a future buying decision; shipping speed or general delivery.

label: Reports False Delivery Status
definition: This cluster groups reports of fraudulent or false delivery statuses where an app marks a prepaid order as delivered without actual receipt.
include_when: The poster ties a false delivery status to a purchase decision — money lost on an order, or it made them distrust the platform or stop buying from it.
exclude_when: A delivery status report with no stated effect on buying; standard returns or general customer service complaints.

label: Product Returns and Warnings
definition: This cluster includes discussions about returning items due to issues, advising others to return products, or warning about return policies and consequences.
include_when: The return or warning is part of deciding whether to buy — e.g. worried about return limits or rules before ordering, or warning others in a buying context.
exclude_when: Pure return-procedure advice or a return-process complaint with no buying-decision link; positive product quality without a return.

label: Return and Replacement Rules
definition: This cluster groups posts where users ask about or describe the return, replacement, or cancellation policies of online purchases. It centers entirely on post-purchase logistical rules.
include_when: The user asks if they can return, replace, or cancel an order after buying.
exclude_when: The post focuses on sizing issues, product quality, or general platform trust without mentioning returns.

label: App Deletion and Quitting
definition: This cluster captures expressions of frustration resulting in users abandoning, deleting, or deciding to permanently stop using a shopping app.
include_when: The post states an intention to delete the app, quit online shopping, or stop making purchases.
exclude_when: The post expresses general satisfaction or merely asks a sizing question.

label: Platform Trust and Creator Reliance
definition: This cluster groups posts where users express trust in a specific online platform's longevity and services, or rely on influencer recommendations for buying clothes. It is about confidence in sources.
include_when: The user explicitly mentions trusting a platform, relying on long-term usage, or trusting creator outfit recommendations.
exclude_when: The post asks direct product questions about sizing, quality, or returns without mentioning trust.

label: Authenticity and Seller Doubts
definition: This cluster encompasses user concerns, questions, and doubts regarding whether a received product or third-party seller is genuine or counterfeit. It relates directly to brand trust and product originality.
include_when: The post questions if a specific seller or product is original, legit, or a dupe.
exclude_when: The post praises product quality or accurate descriptions without questioning authenticity.
example_quotes: ₹2,700 price gap on Myntra — is Flashstar Commerce legit, or should I stick with Adidas India? || Now I'm not sure if the item is original or a dupe.

label: Customer Support and Care Issues
definition: This cluster captures negative feedback, complaints, and experiences regarding unhelpful, rude, or unresponsive customer care and support services.
include_when: The support failure is tied to a purchase the poster depends on (an order, exchange or return) or drove them to stop buying, switch, or distrust the platform.
exclude_when: A standalone service-quality complaint with no buying-decision link; praise of delivery speed or general platform performance.

Even when an exchange is eligible, they don't resolve the issue despite calling customer care multiple times. I'm deleting the app and will never shop from Myntra again

label: General Shopping Satisfaction
definition: This cluster covers overall positive feedback about the shopping experience, app usability, variety, and using shopping as a form of relaxation, plus stated intent to buy the same product again or keep shopping the platform.
include_when: The post reports a great overall shopping experience, satisfaction with the app, or intent to repurchase the same item or keep shopping the platform.
exclude_when: The post focuses strictly on a specific product's physical quality or a single return issue.
example_quotes: I had a great shopping experience on myntra app || had a greatttt shopping experience with myntra. Many variety and good delivery experience

label: Platform and Store Comparisons
definition: This cluster contains posts comparing prices, quality, or preferences between different shopping apps, platforms, or sellers. Users weigh their options across alternative services.
include_when: The post evaluates or contrasts multiple shopping apps, platforms, or online versus store options.
exclude_when: The post focuses solely on product quality or customer service of a single platform.

label: Payment Methods and Orders
definition: This cluster involves questions or statements regarding payment requirements, prepaid orders, cash on delivery workarounds, and first-time orders.
include_when: The post inquires about payment methods, prepaid vs COD terms, or specific order placing steps.
exclude_when: The post focuses purely on applying promotional coupons or discounts.

label: Product Search and App Usability
definition: This cluster captures user experiences regarding platform software navigation, finding specific categories, or struggling with prolonged product searches. It centers on the usability of the shopping interface.
include_when: The user discusses the ease of selecting categories, app software quality, or difficulties in finding specific items.
exclude_when: The post focuses on trust in a platform, store recommendations, or return policies.

label: Mixed Online and Local Shopping
definition: This cluster represents posts where users combine items sourced from online e-commerce platforms and local physical shops into their outfits. It highlights purchasing behavior across multiple channels.
include_when: The user mentions wearing or buying items from a mix of online platforms and local physical shops.

label: Wishlisting and Past Regrets
